judge: one judge, the author of the walls, labelling from the sample alone (alias-precision.mjs --show prints no decisions) BEFORE the wall decisions were opened. Not independent, not a human panel — a proxy, labelled as one.
rule: T = both forms are names or terms for the SAME thing (abbreviation/expansion, short name, translation gloss), so folding them into one referent class would be right wherever either appears in that document. F = anything else: a disambiguator, qualifier, attribute, label, country/party affiliation, equation/code artifact, list annotation, or a pronoun pair (neither form is a name). U = cannot tell from the excerpt; excluded from precision.
order: labels fixed first; decisions opened second; the walls were designed on a different, earlier exploration (seed 7, 40 files per corpus) and never tuned against this sample
